description: Michael (Apt 2) has just entered the unit on check-in day and asks where the crib is. Production auto used the future-guest availability line (Graco Pack and Play already set up and ready). Current guests asking where are looking for it — Apt 2 closet of the smaller bedroom + let us know if you cannot find it.
guestMessage: Just entered the unit. Can you please remind me where the crib is located?

conversationHistory.body: Hello! Can you please confirm what our apt # is?

Good afternoon, Michael, today is not your check-in day — check-in is tomorrow at 4pm. The door code is not on the lock until the morning of your arrival, which is why you can't get in. You're in Apt 2 at 53 Pine Street starting then. See you then!
Looks our reservation isn't until tomorrow, whoops!

context.suggestedResponseSnippet: Michael, it should be in the closet of the smaller bedroom. Let us know if you cannot find it.

requiredPhrases: let us know if you cannot find
